name: AngloGold Ashanti plc
source: CRON 20261014: AngloGold Ashanti plc unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (Form 6-K on SEC EDGAR, filed 31 July 2026, and the same announcement on JSE SENS), US Dollar millions. Printed: Revenue from product sales 6340, Cost of sales 2694, Gross profit 3646, corporate administration marketing and related 89, exploration and evaluation 97, impairment derecognition and disposal 11, other expenses 63, finance income 73, foreign exchange and fair value adjustments 47, finance costs and unwinding 128, share of associates and joint ventures profit 325, Profit before taxation 3609, Taxation 955, Profit for the period 2654 (equity shareholders 2283, non-controlling interests 371), basic earnings per ordinary share 448 US cents. Operating Expenses is the four printed operating items (89 plus 97 plus 11 plus 63 equals 260). Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance income (128 less 73 equals 55). Net Profit is the attributable figure to match the other columns in this file; the non-controlling interest bridge is 371. Check: 3386 less 55 plus 325 less 47 equals 3609 printed profit before taxation; 3609 less 955 equals 2654 total profit for the period.
periods_note: columns dropped: FY2021 - no row in this file carries a figure for them, so they rendered as pure dashes
